items.title: A struct LITERAL's generic fields are checked against the struct's DECLARED bounds instead of the enclosing impl's: inside `impl Outer<type K: PartialEq + Hashable>`, `Outer { inner = Inner::new() }` (where `Inner::new` lives in `impl Inner<type K: PartialEq + Hashable>` and `struct Outer<K: Hashable>`) is refused with `generic parameter 'K' is missing the bound ': PartialEq' required by this call`, while `let inner: Inner<K> = Inner::new(); Outer { inner }` is accepted
items.kind: bug (checker; struct literals and impl bounds)
items.status: OPEN - filed 2026-11-09 (lane lens-s5's find, A185 S5)
items.discussion: met in std/src/reactive/lens/loaded.vl (worked around with the typed `let` and a comment); declaring the bound on the struct instead fails the other way - inside `impl Ledger<type K: PartialEq + Hashable, ..>` the literal `Ledger { .. }` is refused for `missing the bound ': PartialEq' required by 'Ledger'`. Found only because `check_scope_differential`'s full-scan run happened to cover the file (see N196)
items.body: Repro: the eight lines in the lane's report (two generic structs, the inner constructor bounded on the impl). Rec: when a struct literal's field expression is checked, the generic parameters in scope are the ENCLOSING impl's (with its bounds), not the struct declaration's; pin the literal form, the typed-let form and the bound-on-struct form. Sizing S.

items.title: `every_std_module_is_clean_under_full_scan` force-loads only the top-level `std/src/*.vl`: `reactive/lens.vl`, `reactive/lens/loaded.vl`, `reactive/transient.vl` and `rpc/*` are never checked under the full scan, so a std checker defect in a nested module (B716) is caught only if a corpus sweep happens to reach it
items.status: OPEN - filed 2026-11-09 (lane lens-s5's find, A185 S5)
items.discussion: the scoped run of `check_scope_differential` skips std bodies; the full-scan run is the only one that checks std's own code, and its module list is the directory's top level
items.body: Rec: walk `std/src` recursively (every `.vl`), or build the list from the module tree the compiler resolves, so nested modules are covered; pin by asserting the list contains `reactive/lens/loaded.vl`. Sizing XS-S.
